text:
Asha G.: Quick ask from SI partner: they need a compliance packet for the marketplace tile — SOC2 attestation, pen-test executive summary, HSM/KMS attestation (vendor-signed), and our completed supply-chain questionnaire. Procurement wants links next week.

Tom B. (sec): We can assemble. Redaction rules: strip IPs, internal hostnames, serial numbers, customer IDs; replace raw vuln dumps with public CVE links; summarize CVSS>7 as "addressed (mitigated on DATE)".

Marta L. (legal): I'll review and sign the cover letter and questionnaire after Sec confirms redactions. No promotional claims about test results.

Devon R. (infra): Upload plan: originals -> s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/inbound/si-x/ ; outbound redacted bundle -> /outbound/si-x/. Add README.txt explaining redactions + sha256.txt.

Asha G.: Partner requested presigned link TTL=14d. OK?

Tom B. (sec): 14d OK for hardware/SI. Security signoff required before presign. Include integrity note in README: who generated link, TTL, checksum.

notify-bot: Reminder set for @channel: "SI compliance packet due" on 2026-09-15 09:00.

Devon R. (infra): Command I'll use after signoff: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/outbound/si-x/compliance-bundle.zip --expires-in 1209600`

Asha G.: Actions: Devon upload originals Mon noon; Tom do redaction review Mon 16:00; Marta sign Tue 10:00; Devon presign Tue 11:00; Asha send to partner Tue 11:30. I'll log in marketplace tracker and set outbound retention=60 days.

Tom B. (sec): Uploaded redaction notes to inbound/redaction_notes.md. Two items flagged (internal ticket refs).

Devon R. (infra): Redacted bundle v1 uploaded to outbound and sha256.txt included.

Marta L. (legal): Reviewed and signed cover letter. Files moved to outbound.

Tom B. (sec): Security signoff done. No raw exploit details.

Devon R. (infra): Presigned link created and shared with partner (TTL=14d). Link logged in tracker.

Asha G.: Partner confirmed receipt and asked for tentative co-announcement timeline next quarter. Noted.

Marta L. (legal): If partner asks to redistribute artifacts, escalate to legal (legal@redwood.com).

Asha G.: Thanks team — adding this flow to partnerships playbook as a template. Thread closed unless follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
